hero.title: Building Better Connections Between Farms and Markets
hero.subtitle: AgriNova is a Smart Agriculture Marketplace and Decision Support System designed to connect farmers with buyers while providing tools that help agricultural communities make better-informed decisions.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: For decades, traditional agricultural selling across India has depended on fragmented merchant networks, opaque pricing structures, and limited local market visibility. Farmers frequently produce high-quality harvests yet remain cut off from fair value realization due to layers of intermediaries.
story.p2: AgriNova was founded to bridge this foundational gap. By uniting direct digital trading with hyperlocal satellite agro-meteorology and mandi price benchmarks, we empower farmers and commercial buyers to transact with mutual trust, clarity, and speed.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To make agricultural trade more accessible, transparent, and data-informed for farmers and commercial buyers across India.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: A connected agricultural ecosystem where farmers can access wider regional markets and make smarter crop management decisions using useful digital tools.

combines.title: What AgriNova Combines
combines.subtitle: An integrated digital infrastructure designed specifically for Indian agriculture.

items.title: Agricultural Marketplace

items.title: Direct Connections

items.title: Decision Support
